note: Written BEFORE the first rung. §7.4 says 'the four below' and then lists five; all five are recorded here, because the count is a drafting artifact and dropping one would be exactly the reinterpretation the pin exists to prevent.

predictions.claim: Replenishment binds on process/memory count before CPU.
predictions.metric: host MemAvailable + Mlocked + process count vs host CPU utilisation at the knee
predictions.falsifiedBy: CPU saturating at or before the memory gate first refuses
predictions.onlyObservableBecause: §6's memory gate exists; without it the prediction would be 'confirmed' by the host falling over, which is not a measurement

predictions.claim: The warm hot path lands within 2x of the container baseline, because both pay the relay hop and it dominates.
predictions.metric: E10 rung 2 p50 / E10 rung 1 p50

predictions.claim: The knee is a replenishment knee, not a latency knee: cold-acquire rate stays approximately 0 until replenishment rate meets Exec rate, then rises sharply.
predictions.metric: cold-acquire rate vs active runs across E11's rungs
predictions.falsifiedBy: cold-acquire rate rising gradually from the first rung, or p95 degrading while cold-acquire rate stays flat
predictions.note: This predicts the knee's SHAPE, a stronger commitment than a number.

predictions.claim: Cloud Hypervisor's virtio-fs costs more per metadata op than Firecracker's block, visible in ls/find-heavy commands rather than in cat.
predictions.metric: per-command p50 by command class, both arms, E10 rung 2
predictions.falsifiedBy: no arm difference on ls/find, or a difference of the same size on cat

predictions.claim: Idle standby residency returns to zero within StandbyIdle + ReclaimScanInterval of a rung's last Exec on an otherwise idle host, while workspace count does not change until WorkspaceIdle; and because a run's final Exec pops a standby and mints its replacement, the run's full complement of D stands idle rather than being reclaimed, so idle standby residency tracks (runs finishing per StandbyIdle) x D x GuestRAMBytes and not zero.
predictions.metric: idle standby residency and workspace count, sampled after each rung's last Exec
predictions.falsifiedBy: standbys outliving StandbyIdle + ReclaimScanInterval on an idle host, workspaces vanishing before WorkspaceIdle, or residency reading zero rather than (runs finishing) x D
predictions.note: Predicts the reclamation path's SHAPE — convergence with no arrival to trigger it, and RAM released long before state is.
